title: MV How can I make a skill have randomized actions during battle? [VE_BattleMotions]

posts.author: l0vl3y
posts.body: Hi, I'm creating a skill that has a chance to either guard the user, attack the enemy, or heal the team. I figured out how to make the cutscene randomized, but I'm unsure how to make the skill randomized. I used the VE_BattleMotions plugin to help me make a cutscene play during a skill, but I still can't figure out how to make an action randomized during a battle. I've tried countless possibilities, and then the skill always ends up doing nothing and freezing the game. How do I create a skill that randomizes an action during battle? Please let me know if anyone finds a solution. Thank you!

posts.author: alasth
posts.body:
Hi,
@l0vl3y
The idea that comes to me would be:
You create a competence for each effect in your database.
You create the random skill that launches a common event with :
Variable X = random from 1 to 3
Condition if variable X = 1
Launch skill 1
Condition if variable X = 2
Launch skill 2
Condition if variable X = 3
Launch skill 3
